title: DI-fusion publication list (xml-brief)
description: JSON Schema for the xml-brief publication list returned by the Universite libre de Bruxelles DI-fusion Export API at https://difusion-svc.ulb.ac.be/scholar. DI-fusion returns XML, not JSON; this schema describes the element tree so the payload can be validated after conversion. Field set derived from the live response captured in examples/ulb-difusion-scholar-xml-brief.xml on 2026-08-30, cross-checked against pages 6-7 of ULB's own published documentation.
x-source: Live response from https://difusion-svc.ulb.ac.be/scholar?scholarID=19262&scholarInst=ULB&groupBy=genredifusion&markup=ahc&reftype=xml-brief&filetype=xml&language=en (HTTP 200, text/xml, 17,651 bytes, 2026-08-30) plus DI-fusion - Download & API rev. 03/2023, pp. 6-7.

header.description: Rendering header. Present on every response regardless of reftype.

logoInst.description: Server-side path to the institution logo, e.g. /data/difusion-services/conf/awb-ulb-logo.jpg

logoApplication.description: Server-side path to the DI-fusion logo.

title.description: Localised list title, e.g. 'Liste de publications de 19262'.

FullName.description: Resolved display name of the scholar.

body.description: Publication payload. Grouped into grouplevel1/grouplevel2 when groupBy is in effect, otherwise a flat doc list.

title.description: Grouping label, translated per the language parameter.

count.description: Present only when markup contains c, and only at the highest grouping level.

publication.description: One publication. Every field is emitted as an <arr name="..."> list of <str> values, so all are arrays even when single-valued.

seqno.description: Present only when markup contains s or t.

genre.description: DI-fusion publication type. Vocabulary in vocabulary/ulb-difusion-vocabulary.yml.

genrecvulb.description: Publication type in the ULB CV vocabulary.

startpage.description: Handle System URL of the DI-fusion detail page.

abstract.description: Present only when markup contains a.

ftlink_unrestrictedaccess.description: Open-access full text. Present only when markup contains l.

ftlink_restrictedaccess.description: Intranet or embargoed full text. Present only when markup contains l.

ftlink_closedaccess.description: Closed-access full text. Present only when markup contains l.
